name: OpenMHz public-safety radio systems (geocoded seed)
description: Seed catalog of the trunked public-safety radio systems recorded on OpenMHz (api.openmhz.com/systems), geocoded once to city/county/state centroids with OpenStreetMap Nominatim so each system can be placed on the globe. The live catalog and call audio come from OpenMHz at runtime; this file only supplies coordinates and a first paint.
license_note: OpenMHz is a community project (trunk-recorder uploads) with no published API terms; this seed holds only system names, locations and activity averages. Coordinates are derived from OpenStreetMap data (ODbL) via Nominatim, resolved to place centroids, not addresses. Refresh by re-running the geocode against /systems.
